headlines.title: IPQS Says Agent Authorization Alone Won’t Secure Agentic Commerce
headlines.summary: First-party attack intelligence helps businesses assess account, device and payment risk alongside AI-agent authorizationKey facts Agent authorization establishes permissions. Businesses also need to assess whether the account, device or connection involved shows signs of fraud.IPQS gathers firsthand attack intelligence through a proprietary network of more than 100,000 honeypots across over 150 countries.

headlines.title: Capital One Earnings: After a Double Beat the Rally Is On
headlines.summary: Capital One posted Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $6.69, up 12%, with revenue up 6% to $16.3 billion, as the Discover integration drove margin gains despite the stock giving back post-earnings gains.

headlines.title: Is Capital One Financial a Buy After Its Latest Earnings Report?
headlines.summary: Investors clearly thought so, as they snapped up the stock after the third-quarter figures were released.

headlines.title: Capital One (COF) Stock Shrugs At Q3 Earnings Strength
headlines.summary: Capital One Financial just printed Q3 2026 results with a headline that hits investors where it matters most. Earnings per share came in at about US$5.62 and net income reached roughly US$3.4b, yet the stock only moved about 2.5% higher to around US$206 in the first full trading reaction. That muted pop sets up a sentiment test. The market is cheering, but not exuberant, while the profit picture has shifted sharply over the past year and net margins now sit near 20%.

headlines.title: Capital One Launches Limited Time Venture X Business Offer for New Cardholders
headlines.summary: MCLEAN, Va., October 21, 2026--Yesterday, Capital One announced a limited time offer for eligible new Capital One Venture X Business cardholders as part of its ongoing celebration of the card's third anniversary.

description: Capital One Financial Corporation operates as the financial services holding company for the Capital One, National Association, which engages in the provision of various financial products and services in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. It operates through three segments: Credit Card, Consumer Banking, and Commercial Banking. The company accepts checking accounts, money market deposits, negotiable order of withdrawals, savings deposits, time deposits, and sweep accounts. Its loan products include credit card and personal loans; auto and retail banking loans; and commercial and multifamily real estate, and commercial and industrial loans. The company offers credit and debit card products; bank lending; and provides advisory, capital markets, net interchange, treasury management, and depository services. It serves consumers, small businesses, and commercial clients through digital channels, branches, cafés, and other distribution channels located in New York, Louisiana, Texas, Maryland, Virginia, New Jersey, and the District of Columbia. Capital One Financial Corporation was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in McLean, Virginia.
